newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cbank sets two-week rev repo at 18.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech cbank sets two-week rev repo at 18.2 pct.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) said on Monday it would hold a two-week reverse repo tender to drain liquidity at a maximum rate of 18.2 percent, down from 18.5 percent.
The CNB said it would take two bids at a minimum of 100 million crowns before the deadline of 10:10 a.m. (0810 GMT).
The CNB has been performing open market operations almost daily in order to regulate liquidity on the market since currnecy crisis and interest rate hikes in late May.
